title: C# Exceptions: Try..Catch
description: When executing C# code, different errors can occur: coding errors made by the programmer, errors due to wrong input, or other unforeseeable things. The 'try' statement allows you to define a block of code to be tested for errors while it is being executed. The 'catch' statement allows you to define a block of code to be executed, if an error occurs in the try block.

challenges.title: Basic Catch
challenges.exercise: Wrap 'Console.WriteLine(10/0)' in a try-catch block. In catch, print 'Error'.
